item.text: I’ll check Chrome’s local configuration first so I can disable the dark appearance directly instead of walking through the UI manually. If Chrome is following the system theme, I’ll switch the relevant setting to light as well.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme 2>/dev/null || true; gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface gtk-theme 2>/dev/null || true'
